title: Measurable Fatou majorant from left difference quotients of monotone functions
statement: Let F_j : ℝ → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ) be nondecreasing, Z_j : ℝ → [0, ∞], a, b ∈ ℝ and L ∈ ℝ≥0. Suppose Z_j(t) ≤ L · liminf_{h→0⁺} ENNReal.ofReal(h⁻¹) · ENNReal.ofReal(F_j(t) − F_j(t − h)) for all j and all t ∈ (a, b). Then there is a measurable g : ℝ → [0, ∞] such that liminf_j Z_j(t) ≤ g(t) for L¹-a.e. t ∈ (a, b), and ∫⁻_{(a,b)} g dL¹ ≤ L · liminf_j ENNReal.ofReal(F_j(b) − F_j(a)).
lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (Z : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (a b : ℝ) (L : NNReal), (∀ j, Monotone (F j)) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Ioo a b → Z j t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal (F j t - F j (t - h))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), t ∈ Ioo a b → liminf (fun j => Z j t) atTop ≤ g t) ∧ ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun j => ENNReal.ofReal (F j b - F j a)) atTop
